environment: isolated PostgreSQL schema and real NestJS HTTP

checks.description: last administrator protected from disabling, grant removal and role erasure
new account must change password; old/same password rejected and old session revoked
device listing contains no session token; revocation scoped to owner and current session preserved
admin reset revokes all sessions and forces change; self reset cannot bypass current-password verification
parallel attempts are bounded, limits survive API restart, successful login and administrator unlock clear account failures
source limit spans accounts and ignores untrusted forwarding headers
company removal deletes scoped grants; rejoining does not restore them; effective access preview matches service decisions
delegated administrator cannot take over more privileged accounts or escalate assigned roles; ordinary account maintenance remains available
exact origin scheme required and stale-cookie logout remains idempotent
concurrent old-password logins cannot survive a committed administrator reset
sensitive account and session actions are audited without credentials
